lockedMove.excerpt: in my closing statement I'd like to see who has discharged his burden of proof in the debate tonight which view has been shown to be more reasonable as Dr Sanger been able to show that atheism is true I don't think he has in his last speech said I don't have to prove that there is no God well now he does have to support his premises his argument remember had two premises probably if God were to exist there would be good objective evidence of his existence and I gave two reasons for thinking that premise to be dubious neither of which
lockedMove.proposition: Stenger has not sustained either premise of his expected-evidence argument, while origins, morality, and resurrection supply objective evidence.
